description: This is a shell script for generating cryptographic keys and certificates using certtool. It includes functions to generate RSA and ECC keys, self-sign certificates, and sign certificates with a CA. It automates the creation of a certificate hierarchy for testing purposes.

methods.name: gen_rsa_key
methods.description: Generates an RSA key and corresponding public key using certtool.

methods.name: gen_ecc_key
methods.description: Generates an ECC key and corresponding public key using certtool.

methods.name: gen_key
methods.description: Selects and calls the appropriate key generation function based on KEY_TYPE.

methods.name: ca_sign
methods.description: Signs a certificate request or key with a CA certificate.
